ext_description.message: Check one image for AI-provenance signals (Content Credentials, metadata) on request. Nothing is scanned automatically.

options_privacy.message: Local checks (Content Credentials and image metadata) run on this machine and are never uploaded. An OpenAI check runs only after you confirm it in a separate window; it sends the image to OpenAI and may be billed. Use a dedicated project key with a spend limit.

confirm_body.message: This image will be sent to OpenAI to check for provenance signals. Checks may be billed to your OpenAI account.

popup_caveat_no_signal.message: No signal does not mean the image is human-made.
